channel.name: Why It Works
channel.niche: the reason behind the science students learn and the science being discovered now: physics, chemistry, biology, maths, electronics and technology; one concept per video, shown step by step, then WHY it works in one line of school-level science; new open-access research explained at school level
channel.audience: school and early-college students worldwide (ages 13-22) and curious adults; English, auto-dubbed to Hindi and Spanish; they know some school science and want the reason, not a lecture
channel.voice_tone: clear, warm, a good teacher who is excited by the idea; never talks down, never clickbait-false
channel._note: Sister channel of Ever Thought Why? (created 14 Nov 2026, handle @whyitworksstem). Visuals are drawn by code first (Manim, diagrams, maps), real footage second; a viral trick that only works for special numbers is called out.
channel.how_made: How this was made: the script is researched and fact-checked with AI tools against open-access research and textbooks, narrated by an AI voice, and every diagram, number and graph is drawn by code from the real values. Spot a mistake? Tell us in the comments - corrections are checked and credited.
channel.logo_desc: a white right triangle with blue and yellow squares on its sides, on navy

publish.timezone_note: 07:30 ET = 18:00 IST (Indian students after school), 16:30 ET = US after school

animate._note: code-drawn first: up to 5 computed animations per video (main channel: 2)
